title: Escalated page manifest
description: Every Inertia page name the shared frontend resolves, and the props each one reads. A backend rendering a name that is not in `pages` produces a blank panel, not an error.

version.description: The @escalated-dev/escalated release this manifest was generated from.

pages.description: Page names, sorted. Each must resolve to a component in the frontend package.

props.description: Keyed by page name. Lists the props the component reads, and which of them it cannot render without.
